name: Asahi Printing Co.,Ltd.
summary: Asahi Printing Co., Ltd. produces and distributes printing and packaging solutions for the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, mainly in Japan. Its offerings include packaging for over-the-counter and prescription drugs, roll labels, leaflets and cosmetic items, as well as packaging machinery such as blister packing and liquid filling systems. Dating from 1872, it has its headquarters in Toyama, Japan.
